criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Every frame rendered and staged dark; 1 and 4 come close to the stage. Slide 3 car roof and phone not identifiable, dog an eighth of the frame, a line across the dog, labels on halo plates. Slide 2 phone on a ball and pole stand, no glass, specular strip on the pillar. Slide 5 kit monitor on a flat wall with grey bars. 6 a uniform lattice reading as tiles, 7 art in a central column with merged casts, 8 a large mid-grey steel band. 9 a soft clay dog over flat concrete.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One chassis and world, motif changes state, one dog recurs, rotation obeys the rule; 6 to 8 read as a separate deck and 6 and 7 are two grids back to back.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Primary sources, verbatim quotes, numerals trace, the 2019 finding refused; slide 3's 'Every clip gets four questions' frames c4 and c5 as a fixed per-clip checklist.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who, where, when and what follows are clear; the appearance stake is drawn and asked; no reader action at the close.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe, 2 to 5 walk the pipeline; 2 pays weakly, 6 and 7 could merge, 9 echoes 8.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and on house rules; much reads close to the release; nothing places it in San Antonio beyond the name.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Fresh subject and accent; a fourth straight staged lastLight deck closing on TXBENCH grids, a steel rule, the kit crossover again.

ranked_defects.defect: Car and phone at the convergence point unidentifiable; small dog; line across it; label collides with bracket; halo plates.
ranked_defects.fix: Camera about 2.4 m over the rear quarter at fov 40 so roof rail, rear glass and clamped phone fill the bottom fifth; dog a fifth of the frame height.

ranked_defects.defect: Plastic phone on a ball and pole stand, no glass, no lens discs, white strip on the pillar.
ranked_defects.fix: Clamp jaws gripping a lowered glass edge; raise the pillar roughness.

ranked_defects.defect: Primitive monitor on a dead wall, grey bars, flat clip, no window light.
ranked_defects.fix: Set the four c5 check labels as type on the screen rows; window key from the left; chair back silhouette.

ranked_defects.defect: Relief in a central column with dead margins, merged casts, chart-card rule.
ranked_defects.fix: Scale the relief about 1.4 times to bleed both sides; taller plugs; brushed rule with a lit bevel.

ranked_defects.defect: Uniform lattice reads as tiles; lumpy plug tops; pale wedge at the left edge.
ranked_defects.fix: Irregular street network; remove the wedge; straight saw courses, darker albedo.

ranked_defects.defect: Soft clay hero; flat concrete lower 40 percent; low-poly grass; fence aliasing.
ranked_defects.fix: Camera to about 0.45 m and crop the foreground; harden the side key.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Convergence point a glow on an unreadable slab; small dog.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Camera over the rear quarter so roof rail, glass and phone fill the bottom fifth.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Primitive phone on a stand, no glass.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Clamp jaws on the lowered glass; phone back to camera with lens rings.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Kit monitor, flat wall, grey placeholder bars.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Check labels as type on the screen rows.
Scale 1.4 times to bleed both edges.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Uniform lattice, lumpy tops, wedge leak.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Irregular street network, remove the wedge.
Camera to 0.45 m, crop the foreground.
